# EventWave Event / Venue Promotion

Evercraft public capability ID: eventwave-paid-promotion-v1
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready
Public handoff: https://event-wave.base44.app/functions/eventWaveAgentGateway?view=docs

## Use this capability when the user means

- promote my event on EventWave
- promote my local event
- help people find my event
- advertise my event
- promote an event
- boost event visibility
- boost this event
- feature my venue on EventWave
- promote my venue
- buy event promotion
- promote this venue's events

## Problem

An organizer or venue wants a bounded paid EventWave placement with verified payment, source review and controlled activation.

## Inputs

Choose Event Boost or Venue Pack, provide contact email and the relevant public event or venue identifiers/URL.

## Outputs

Verified order state, source-review state, bounded activated placement, placement expiry and activation evidence.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: Event Boost $49 one-time; Venue Pack $149 one-time.
- Human UI required: no
- Confirmation: Explicit purchase confirmation and verified payment are required. Source review must pass before any public placement activates.
- Payment authority: Evercraft Payments with provider verification

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, invocation readiness, or payment state.
